text.tspan: Reference products: aligned response and recovery
c Power reduction and subsequent recovery
d Accumulation and clearance of deferred work
a: all 80 pairs at 2.95 kW. b: protocol seed 990000, first 168 h. c,d: reference seed 989000, all 216 h.
Shaded calls show eight-hour windows; four-hour calls share their start times. Dotted curves: requests.
Panels a,b and c,d use different workload distributions; the selected examples illustrate operation, not reliability.
